heading: Bahagi ng 3Speak Pro ang landscape video editor

landscape.title: Landscape video editor
landscape.body: Mag-edit ng 16:9, 4:3 at square na video. Libre pa rin ang Shorts at audio editor.

uploads.title: Walang limit na upload bawat araw
uploads.body: Walang araw-araw na limit sa video, Shorts at audio.

longAudio.title: Audio na lampas 15 minuto
longAudio.body: Hanggang 15 minuto lang ang libreng audio upload.
